gold.user: A user wants to retrieve a list of all SIP Credential Lists associated with their Twilio account to manage their SIP configurations.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON array of SIP Credential Lists, including details such as SID, friendly name, and date created.

gold.user: A user needs to create a new SIP Credential List to group their SIP credentials for better organization.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON payload with the required fields and return the SID of the newly created Credential List along with its details.

gold.user: A user wants to fetch details of a specific SIP Credential List to review its contents and settings.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON object containing the details of the specified SIP Credential List, including its SID, friendly name, and associated credentials.

gold.user: A user needs to update an existing SIP Credential List to change its friendly name or add new credentials.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON payload with the updated fields and return the updated details of the SIP Credential List.

gold.user: A user wants to delete a SIP Credential List that is no longer needed to keep their account organized.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the specified SIP Credential List and return a success message.
